revisions.note: Resumed from the rev-1 seed. The root cause is now re-measured LIVE on the unit (the handset is in charger/LPM mode right now) rather than only quoted from earlier cycles, the guard configuration has its own subpath as the briq asks, and the status output names the config used plus a machine-readable line for the live console. The kernel-level fix remains BLOCKED_KERNEL / BOOT_UPDATE_REQUIRED / NOT_DEPLOYED; no userspace code pretends to resurrect the driver.
